seoTitle: Cost Per Square Foot Calculator - Real Estate & Flooring
metaDescription: Free online Cost Per Square Foot Calculator. Instantly calculate the price of a home, flooring, or commercial real estate based on square footage.
intro: Buying a house or installing new hardwood floors? Our free Cost Per Square Foot Calculator quickly determines the exact price per unit area so you can easily compare properties and material estimates.
whatIs: The Cost Per Square Foot Calculator is a real estate and construction financial tool. It calculates the unit rate of an area (Price ÷ Total Square Feet), allowing you to compare the relative value of properties or materials of completely different sizes.
howToUse: Enter the total cost of the property or the materials.
The tool instantly divides the numbers to reveal the Cost Per Square Foot.
Alternatively, enter the square footage and price per square foot to find the total expected cost.
howItWorks: The tool uses simple algebraic division and multiplication. To find the unit price, it divides the Total Cost by the Total Area. To find a project budget, it multiplies the Area by the Material Unit Price.
workedExample: A 2,500 square foot house is listed for $500,000. $500,000 / 2,500 = $200. The home costs exactly $200 per square foot.
resultInterpretation: The resulting dollar amount represents the value of a 1 foot by 1 foot square of the property. This metric is the industry standard for comparing whether one house is a 'better deal' than another.
useCases: Real Estate: Comparing the value of a $400,000, 1,500 sq ft condo vs a $450,000, 2,000 sq ft house.
Home Renovation: Calculating the total budget required to install $4.50/sq ft luxury vinyl plank flooring in a 600 sq ft living room.
Commercial Leasing: Determining the monthly rent for office space priced at $30 per square foot per year.
tipsAndLimitations: In real estate, a lower cost per square foot does not always mean a better deal. It may indicate a home that needs major repairs or is in a less desirable neighborhood.
When estimating flooring, always add 10% to your total square footage to account for waste and cuts.

faq.question: Does square footage include the garage?
faq.answer: In standard residential real estate, 'livable' square footage usually only includes finished, heated/cooled spaces. Garages and unfinished basements are excluded.

faq.question: How do I calculate the square footage of a room?
faq.answer: Simply measure the length and width of the room in feet, and multiply those two numbers together.

cta: Calculate your square footage cost now!
disclaimer: Tool provides mathematical estimates. Real estate listings may calculate total square footage differently depending on local regulations and appraisal standards.
